body:
It started out when my dad got a prescription for Aderol. My sister had gone through her own addiction and I wanted to try it.
It started out I took one every once in a while, then every morning he would leave his pills on the kitchen counter, I would take a couple and roll through the week. School and everything else was great on it.
After a while I stopped feeling one, or two, so I started taking three every day. I would take three and go to school, I would throw up and I would feel so shitty the only thing I could focus on was how shitty I felt. But I didn't stop and I just went back down to two a day.
After two weeks my older sister found out she told me I had to quit. I had already been thin and I lost some weight and was looking bad. So I quit.
The three days afterwards went by so slowly, I had no idea of my surroundings and all of my thoughts got jumbled. When someone would ask me a question I would think then say; 'Yes, no, wait. I don't know.' And I ended up skipping two days of school after I sat all alone through lunch unable to think of anything.
Its a fun drug, but the come downs not worth the high.
